events.name: onDrawerOpen
events.description: Fired when the drawer opens. Detail: `{ active }` — the new open state.

events.name: onDrawerClose
events.description: Fired when the drawer closes by any means. Detail: `{ active }`.

events.name: onDrawerCloseButton
events.description: Fired only when the drawer's close button is activated. Detail: `{ active }`. Use `onDrawerClose` to catch every close path.

width.description: Width of drawer panel when expanded / collapsed as side panel

hasBackdrop.description: Fade/ghost back the page background content

isActive.description:
Is active?
- **true** Shows the drawer container
- **false** Hides the drawer container

ariaLabelledBy.description:
Aria Labelled By attribute
- Dynamically set for A11y

disableBackdropClick.description: Disable to close the drawer on outside click
